decision: Use learned per-feature gated interactions for all default PRISM training recipes; preserve explicit historical actor schemas.
scope: Computation graphs, observation interfaces, and checkpoint compatibility for supported policy integrations.

g1_residual_poly_v1.actor_input_components: 15 frames of gait phase, velocity commands, joint positions/velocities, previous actions, and inertial measurements; preserve the exact source order and scaling.
g1_residual_poly_v1.parameter_count_note: Actor mean includes the encoder and actor MLP. Total also includes critic and Gaussian standard-deviation parameters; buffers are excluded.
g1_residual_poly_v1.gate_semantics: Scalar buffer min(completed PPO updates / warmup updates, 1); fixed variants use 1.
g1_residual_poly_v1.compatibility_note: Main comparison and fixed degree-2 ablation use different warmup settings.
g1_residual_poly_v1.status: legacy; retained for historical checkpoints and explicit recipes

g1_residual_learned_gate_v1.status: diagnostic only; preserves the historical residual actor, not the default shared gated recurrence
g1_residual_learned_gate_v1.gate_semantics: Unconstrained learned per-feature alpha multiplying each residual interaction term; initial shared weights and forward function match the legacy actor.
g1_residual_learned_gate_v1.compatibility_note: Explicit diagnostic schema; legacy and default gated checkpoints are rejected. Historical results do not measure this learned-gate control.

diffusion_factorized_state_v1.gate_semantics: No gate or scheduled scale; multiply two affine factors directly.
diffusion_factorized_state_v1.normalization_before_module: Use the saved policy preprocessor; inspected main task0 configs specify MIN_MAX for state.
diffusion_factorized_state_v1.history_order: Flatten state history, combined image-feature history, and optional environment-state history separately, then concatenate in that order. Camera features are concatenated within each timestep before image-history flattening.
diffusion_factorized_state_v1.status: legacy; retained for historical checkpoints and explicit recipes

smolvla_gated_quadratic_v1.output_norm: RMSNorm outside state_proj; preserve historical dtype arithmetic
smolvla_gated_quadratic_v1.gate_semantics: Learned per-latent-feature quadratic_scale, initialized to 0.01; right affine bias initialized to zero.
smolvla_gated_quadratic_v1.compatibility_note: Historical baseline/larger normalization and multi-seed checkpoint identity remain unverified.

bfm_history_gated_quadratic_v1.output_norm: RMSNorm inside history filter; preserve historical dtype arithmetic
bfm_history_gated_quadratic_v1.gate_semantics: Learned per-latent-feature quadratic_scale, initialized to 0.01; right affine bias initialized to zero.
bfm_history_gated_quadratic_v1.compatibility_note: Distinct from the older development PrismActor over all concatenated observations.

core_gated_v1.compatibility_note: Reusable API, not a historical checkpoint loader. Float32 degree-2 parity with stronger-backbone branches requires explicit weight mapping and matched activation/norm.

core_factorized_v1.compatibility_note: Reusable API; no claim that its normalization/projection or checkpoint layout matches the main Diffusion adapter.

g1_gated_poly_v2.status: default for new G1 PRISM training; requires new checkpoints and results
g1_gated_poly_v2.gate_semantics: Unconstrained trainable vector per added factor; one value per latent feature
g1_gated_poly_v2.projection: Linear(256,256) followed by ELU; no historical raw residual skip

capacity_variant.note: Same gated recurrence with wider latent features and a one-unit first actor-layer adjustment. Requires its own recipe and freshly trained checkpoint.

g1_gated_poly_v2.compatibility_note: Distinct computation and schema from g1_residual_poly_v1; no automatic weight conversion.

diffusion_gated_state_v2.gate_semantics: Learned per-latent-feature quadratic_scale, initialized to 0.01; right affine bias initialized to zero.
diffusion_gated_state_v2.normalization_before_module: Use the saved policy preprocessor; inspected main task0 configs specify MIN_MAX for state.
diffusion_gated_state_v2.history_order: Flatten state history, combined image-feature history, and optional environment-state history separately, then concatenate in that order. Camera features are concatenated within each timestep before image-history flattening.
diffusion_gated_state_v2.status: default for new Diffusion PRISM training; requires new checkpoints and results
diffusion_gated_state_v2.compatibility_note: Gate parameter is required for gated mode and forbidden in legacy mode, including non-strict policy loads.

shared_interaction.input: Backbone-selected state/history after its documented preprocessing
shared_interaction.gate_parameterization: Unconstrained trainable vector per added factor; one value per latent feature
shared_interaction.optimization: Backbone native loss; saved with policy and fixed during evaluation
shared_interaction.scope: Interaction recurrence; preprocessing, projections, activations, norms, and losses remain backbone-specific
